decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-ade0be673ee4] names the subject (the distroless/static base image) and the change (a digest bump from 95ea148 to 3d0f463, made by an automated dependabot PR), and says nothing about any effect on operators. The "BREAKING CHANGES" heading does not by itself mark this item as breaking: the same list mixes routine CI-action bumps [ev-86762bb5fcce], docs fixes [ev-ad7162c77c9e] and features [ev-61893aebc612]. The image:tag refutation and the "referenced by neither release's manifests" result suggest this is a build-time base image rather than an image operators deploy, so applicability should not be written as a deployed-image condition. Confidence is low because the PR is not shown and the consequence ("none") is inferred from the evidence saying nothing, not stated outright.
